scope: Numeric data source audit for offshore market dashboard JSON files

medium_risk.issue: 48 of 77 rigs carry source/source_url/confidence from FSR cross-reference (2026-05-05). Remaining 29 rigs lack item-level source fields.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Extend source enrichment to remaining rigs using next FSR cycle; prioritise rigs on contract with no source_url.

medium_risk.issue: Contractor backlog/fleet counts now carry source/as_of/source_url. Vessel oil/gas capacity fields still lack item-level source URLs.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Add source_url to individual vessel capacity fields using operator/contractor project pages in the next update cycle.

medium_risk.issue: capex_guidance entries now carry source_url (IR landing pages). Key project capacity/reserve/timeline values still rely on source text without item-level URLs.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Add source_url for major project pages or filings in next update cycle.

medium_risk.issue: Quarterly financials now carry source_url (IR landing pages) and market_cap_snapshot_date. Specific press release URLs per quarter not yet linked.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Link specific quarterly press release PDFs/pages per period when updating.

medium_risk.issue: Quarterly financials now carry source_url (IR landing pages) and market_cap_snapshot_date. Non-calendar fiscal years (MODEC, Yinson) require careful period mapping.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Link specific earnings releases per period; verify MODEC/Yinson fiscal year alignment.

lower_risk.issue: named_observations added (9 FSR-verified contracts with source_url). Indicative curve confidence upgraded to medium. Jack-up tier still lacks contract-level anchors.
lower_risk.recommended_action: Add jack-up named observations from Borr / Valaris jack-up FSR in next cycle.

lower_risk.issue: News items include URLs and source names.
lower_risk.recommended_action: Keep using primary company releases where available; use trade press only for market color.

source_policy.primary: Company filings, earnings releases, fleet status reports, contractor project pages and operator project pages.
source_policy.secondary: Offshore Energy, Offshore Magazine, World Oil, Rigzone and other trade press for transaction context or market color.
source_policy.volatile_values: Market cap, current dayrate, active fleet count and backlog should carry snapshot dates.
source_policy.estimates: Estimated or directional values must be labelled with basis and confidence, not presented as verified observations.
